name: The Treaty of Understanding

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can read this stone tablet as a record of reconciliation. Your ancestors set aside their feud after the mountain was contested.
The historic peace between Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarves laid the foundation for their modern cooperation within the Grand Alliance.

faq.answer: The Treaty of Understanding is an ancient stone tablet recovered from deep vaults. It records the formal peace made between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans just after the War of the Three Hammers ended.
faq.q: What is the Treaty of Understanding?

faq.answer: Madoran Bronzebeard drafted the treaty after the War of the Three Hammers, while he ruled as the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge. The three clans had fought for control of the mountain.
The Dark Iron clan refused peace after the Bronzebeards took control of Ironforge. Only the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans signed the agreement, leaving the Dark Irons isolated and hostile.
faq.q: Why did the Dark Iron clan not sign the treaty?

aliases: who do i give treaty of understanding to
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard receives the tablet in the High Seat of Ironforge. He values it as a relic of his ancestor Madoran and of dwarven history.
faq.q: Who is interested in the Treaty of Understanding?

aliases: what was the war of the three hammers
faq.answer: The War of the Three Hammers was a bitter civil war between the Bronzebeard, Wildhammer, and Dark Iron dwarf clans for control of Ironforge mountain. The Bronzebeards won the mountain and drove out the other clans.
faq.q: What was the War of the Three Hammers?

faq.answer: Madoran Bronzebeard was King Magni Bronzebeard’s ancestor and the first Bronzebeard king to rule Ironforge after the civil war among the three dwarven clans.

sections.body: You find a stone tablet deep in an ancient vault. Its words record a formal end to hostilities between dwarf clans. The treaty belongs to the troubled years after the War of the Three Hammers, when the Bronzebeards secured control of Ironforge mountain. Then came peace between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans.
sections.title: A Relic of Dwarven Reconciliation

sections.body: King Magni Bronzebeard knows the tablet as the work of his ancestor, Madoran Bronzebeard, the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge. The Bronzebeard and Wildhammer leaders signed the document. The Dark Iron clan left no mark, and their absence tells of the lasting rift between them and their mountain kin.
sections.title: The Unsigned Peace

summary: After the War of the Three Hammers, The Treaty of Understanding marks a peace between two dwarf clans. Its ancient words record the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer agreement, while the Dark Iron clan remains apart.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Treaty of Understanding
